blocks.content: Typically, a modern webpage is created using three languages:

items: HTML - Defines the structure of the webpage.
CSS - Adds design and style to the webpage.
JavaScript - Adds interactivity to the webpage.

I don’t understand when you say structure of the webpage ,what is it exactly ?
When we talk about the structure of a webpage, we’re referring to the content you see—like headings, paragraphs, images, and links.
HTML helps you add these elements to your webpage, but without any custom styling or interactive features.
Once you have these elements in place, you can use CSS to style them or JavaScript to add functionality, like animations or user interactions.
